articles.summary: Lagos, Nigeria. May 27, 2024 – Amidst challenging economic conditions across West Africa, Tizeti Network Limited, the region’s leading solar-powered fixed internet service provider, has not only sustained profitability but is set to distribute its third consecutive annual dividend to shareholders for the fiscal year ending December 31st, 2023, at a rate of N0.03 (3 kobo) per share.
